title: add_days_iso performs only a single month rollover, producing invalid dates like 2026-09-48 for larger validity_days
detail: Only the current month's length is subtracted once. Aug 19 + 45 days yields "2026-09-33", +60 yields "2026-09-48" — malformed timestamps stored in Vacancy.closes_at.
recommended_fix: Loop while new_d exceeds days_in_month(new_y, new_m), or compute via ordinal day arithmetic, so any validity_days yields a valid date.

title: Created demo vacancies always get days_remaining 0; the carefully computed closes_at is never consumed, contradicting create_vacancy's own comment
detail: Every created vacancy ("v-demo-*") falls into `_ -> 0`, rendering as closing immediately — exactly what the comment says must not happen. closes_at is dead data.
recommended_fix: Derive days_remaining from the vacancy's own closes_at/created_at (i.e. validity_days) instead of the id-keyed hardcoded table.

title: Hardcoded remindable_count 2 / followup_count 1 for every vacancy contradict the awaiting list they describe
evidence:
awaiting_count: awaiting_count_for(vac.id),
    remindable_count: 2,
    followup_count: 1,
--- vs ---
fn awaiting_count_for(vacancy_id: String) -> Int {
  case vacancy_id {
    "v-maples" -> 3
    _ -> 0
  }
}
--- and in awaiting("v-maples"), the only un-reminded applicant: ---
      AwaitingApplicant(
        email: "emma.doyle@example.ie",
        name: Some("Emma Doyle"),
        invited_at: "2026-08-15T10:00:00Z",
        reminded: False,
detail: v-maples has 1 remindable awaiting applicant, detail reports 2; all other vacancies (and archived/new ones) report 2 remindable with 0 awaiting. Parallel non-derived numbers drift, contra module header.
recommended_fix: Compute remindable_count/followup_count (and awaiting_count) from the same per-vacancy awaiting data instead of constants and id-keyed tables.

                    ..app,

detail: No precondition on current status: repeated opens reset Approved/Shortlisted back to under_review and grow audit_trail with duplicate status_auto_changed entries each time.

title: Deterministic id_suffix guarantees id and short_code collisions for repeated or 8-char-prefix-sharing property names, despite its anti-collision comment
detail: Same property name (or shared 8-char truncated prefix) yields identical vacancy id and short_code; find_vacancy then only ever mutates the first match, and keyed UI lists get duplicate keys.
recommended_fix: Append a per-store disambiguator (e.g. vacancy count or a counter) to the suffix so created ids are unique within a session.

title: Approval refetches the leaderboard post-mutation; rejection and backward transitions perform the same mutation without the refetch
detail: The stated staleness rationale applies identically to rejection and backward transitions: their leaderboard rows stay stale (or approval double-fetches if the response arm already refetches).
recommended_fix: Apply the same post-mutation leaderboard refetch (from the updated store) in UserConfirmedRejection and UserConfirmedBackwardTransition.

title: gleam/option import in demo_api.gleam is unused
detail: No Option, None, or Some appears anywhere in the 461-line module; dead import producing a compiler warning.

title: id_suffix's doc comment is pasted onto add_days_iso, leaving both misdocumented
detail: The first sentence describes id_suffix, not add_days_iso; id_suffix itself ends up with no documentation.
recommended_fix: Move the "Stable short id suffix..." sentence onto id_suffix's own doc comment.

title: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores the page parameter and always returns the full leaderboard
detail: The mirrored endpoint is paginated; this returns every entry for any page, so append-style load-more handling duplicates rows and replace-style makes load-more a no-op.
recommended_fix: Slice the leaderboard entries by _page and page size before delivering, mirroring the real endpoint's pagination.

title: Reset demo silently no-ops when seeding fails — no feedback of any kind
detail: The user clicks "Reset demo" and nothing happens — no toast, no state change — inconsistent with the feedback pattern this module applies elsewhere.
recommended_fix: On the Error arm, dispatch a brand-voice toast (e.g. copy.demo reset failure) so the dead click is never silent.
